verses.speaker: धृतराष्ट्र
verses.english: Dhritarâshtra said: On the holy plain, on the field of Kuru, gathered together, eager for battle, what did they, O Sanjaya, my people and the Pândavas?

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Having seen arrayed the army of the Pândavas, the Prince Duryodhana approached his teacher, and spake these words:

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: "Behold this mighty host of the sons of Pându, O teacher, arrayed by the son of Drupada, thy wise disciple.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Heroes are these, mighty bowmen, to Bhîma and Arjuna equal in battle: Yuyudhâna, Virâta, and Drupada of the great car.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Drishtaketu, Chekitâna and the valiant King of Kâshi, Purujit and Kuntibhoja, and Shaivya, bull among men;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Yudhâmanyu the strong, and Uttamaujas the brave; Saubhadra and the Draupadeyas, all of great cars.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम ।
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ॥
iast: asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama |
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te ||
verses.english: Know further all those who are our chiefs, O best of the twice-born, the leaders of my army; these I name to thee for thy information:

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Thou, Lord, and Bhîshma, and Karna and Kripa, conquering in battle; Ashvatthâmâ, Vikarna, and Saumadatti also;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः ।
iast: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ |
verses.english: And many others, heroes, for my sake renouncing their lives, with divers weapons and missiles, and all well-skilled in war.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Yet insufficient seems this army of ours, though marshalled by Bhîshma, while that army of theirs seems sufficient, though marshalled by Bhîma;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Therefore in the rank and file let all, standing firmly in their respective divisions, guard Bhîshma, even all ye generals.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: To enhearten him, the Ancient of the Kurus, the Grandsire, the glorious, blew his conch, sounding on high a lion's roar.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then conches and kettledrums, tabors and drums and cowhorns, suddenly blared forth, and the sound was tumultuous.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then, stationed in their great war-chariot, yoked to white horses, Mâdhava and the son of Pându blew their divine conches.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Pânchajanya by Hrishîkesha, and Devadatta by Dhananjaya. Vrikodara of terrible deeds blew his mighty conch, Paundra;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: The King Yudhishthira, the son of Kuntî, blew Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva, Sughosha and Manipushpaka.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: And Kâshya, of the great bow and Shikhandî, the mighty car-warrior, Drishtadyumna and Virâta and Sâtyaki, the unconquered.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Drupada and the Draupadeyas, O Lord of earth, and Saubhadra, the mighty-armed, on all sides their several conches blew.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: That tumultuous uproar rent the hearts of the sons of Dhritarâshtra, filling the earth and sky with sound.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then, beholding the sons of Dhritarâshtra standing arrayed, and flight of missiles about to begin, he whose crest is an ape, the son of Pându, took up his bow,

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: And spake this word to Hrishîkesha, O Lord of Earth: Arjuna said: In the midst, between the two armies, stay my chariot, O Achyuta,

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: That I may behold these standing, longing for battle, with whom I must strive in this outbreaking war,

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: And gaze on those here gathered together ready to fight, desirous of pleasing in battle the evil-minded son of Dhritarâshtra.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Thus addressed by Gudâkesha, Hrishîkesha, O Bhârata, having stayed that best of chariots in the midst, between the two armies,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Over against Bhîshma, Drona and all the rulers of the world, said: "O Pârtha, behold these Kurus gathered together."

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then saw Pârtha standing there, uncles and grandfathers, teachers, mother's brothers, cousins, sons and grandsons, comrades,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Fathers-in-law and benefactors also in both armies; seeing all these kinsmen thus standing arrayed, Kaunteya,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Deeply moved to pity, thus uttered in sadness: Arjuna said: Seeing these my kinsmen, O Krishna, arrayed, eager to fight,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति ।
iast: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati |
verses.english: My limbs fail and my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ॥
iast: na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ ||
verses.english: Gândîva slips from my hand, and my skin burns all over, I am not able to stand, my mind is whirling,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: And I see adverse omens, O Keshava. Nor do I foresee any advantage from slaying kinsmen in battle.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च ।
किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा ॥
iast: na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca |
kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā ||
verses.english: For I desire not victory, O Krishna, nor kingdom, nor pleasures; what is kingdom to us, O Govinda, what enjoyment or even life?

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च ।
त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च ॥
iast: yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca |
ta ime’avasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca ||
verses.english: Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures, they stand here in battle, abandoning life and riches—

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Teachers, fathers, sons, as well as grandfathers, mother's brothers, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ॥
iast: api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte ||
verses.english: These I do not wish to kill, though myself slain, O Madhusûdana, even for the sake of the kingship of the three worlds; how then for earth?

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Slaying these sons of Dhritarâshtra, what pleasure can be ours, O Janârdana? Killing these desperadoes, sin will but take hold of us.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव ॥
iast: svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava ||
verses.english: Therefore we should not kill the sons of Dhritarâshtra, our relatives; for how, killing our kinsmen, may we be happy, O Mâdhava?

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Although these, with intelligence overpowered by greed, see no guilt in the destruction of a family, no crime in hostility to friends,

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Why should not we learn to turn away from such a sin, O Janârdana, who see the evils in the destruction of a family?

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: In the destruction of a family the immemorial family traditions perish; in the perishing of tradition, lawlessness overcomes the whole family;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Owing to predominance of lawlessness, O Krishna, the women of the family become corrupt; women corrupted, O Vârshneya, there ariseth caste confusion;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: This confusion draggeth to hell the slayers of the family, and the family; for their ancestors fall, deprived of rice-balls and libations.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: By these caste-confusing misdeeds of the slayers of the family, the everlasting caste customs and family customs are abolished.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: The abode of the men whose family customs are extinguished, O Janârdana, is everlastingly in hell. Thus have we heard.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् ।
iast: aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam |
verses.english: Alas! in committing a great sin are we engaged, we who are endeavouring to kill our kindred from greed of the pleasures of kingship.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: If the sons of Dhritarâshtra, weapon in hand, should slay me, unresisting, unarmed, in the battle, that would for me be the better.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken on the battle-field, Arjuna sank down on the seat of the chariot, casting away his bow and arrow, his mind overborne by grief.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: To him thus with pity overcome, with smarting brimming eyes, despondent, Madhusûdana spake these words:

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Whence hath this dejection befallen thee in this perilous strait, ignoble, heaven-closing, infamous, O Arjuna?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते ।
iast: klaibyaṃ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitattvayyupapadyate |
verses.english: Yield not to impotence, O Partha! it doth not befit thee. Shake off this paltry faint-heartedness! Stand up, Parantapa!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: कथं भीष्ममहं सङ्ख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन ।
iast: kathaṃ bhīṣmamahaṃ saṅkhye droṇaṃ ca madhusūdana |
verses.english: Arjuna said: How, O Madhusûdana, shall I attack Bhîshma and Drona with arrows in battle, they who are worthy of reverence, O slayer of foes?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān śreyo bhoktuṃ bhaikṣyamapīha loke |
verses.english: Better in this world to eat even the beggar's crust than to slay these most noble Gurus. Slaying these Gurus, our well-wishers, I should taste of blood-besprinkled feasts.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः ।
iast: na caitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ |
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣāmaḥ te’avasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ ||
verses.english: Nor know I which for us be the better, that we conquer them or they conquer us—these, whom having slain we should not care to live, even these arrayed against us, the sons of Dhritarâshtra.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: yacchreyaḥ syānniścitaṃ brūhi tanme śiṣyaste’ahaṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam ||
verses.english: My heart is weighed down with the vice of faintness; my mind is confused as to duty. I ask thee which may be the better—that tell me decisively. I am thy disciple, suppliant to Thee; teach me.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: For I see not that it would drive away this anguish that withers up my senses, if I should attain unrivalled monarchy on earth, or even the sovereignty of the Shining Ones.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह ॥
iast: na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha ||
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Gudâkesha, conqueror of his foes, having thus addressed Hrishîkesha and said to Govinda, "I will not fight!", became silent.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then Hrishîkesha, smiling, as it were, O Bhârata, spake these words to him, despondent, in the midst of the two armies:

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Thou grievest for those that should not be griev ed for, yet speakest words of wisdom. The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः ।
न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम् ॥
iast: na tvevāhaṃ jātu nāsaṃ na tvaṃ neme janādhipāḥ |
na caiva na bhaviṣyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param ||
verses.english: Nor at any time verily was I not, nor thou, nor these princes of men, nor verily shall we ever cease to be, hereafter.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As the dweller in the body experienceth in the body childhood, youth, old age, so passeth he on to another body; the steadfast one grieveth not thereat.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The contacts of matter, O son of Kuntî, giving cold and heat, pleasure and pain, they come and go, impermanent; endure them bravely, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ ।
iast: yaṃ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha |
verses.english: The man whom these torment not, O chief of men, balanced in pain and pleasure, steadfast, he is fitted for immortality.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः ।
iast: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ |
verses.english: The unreal hath no being; the real never ceaseth to be; the truth about both hath been perceived by the seers of the essence of things.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
iast: avināśi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam |
verses.english: Know That to be indestructible by whom all this is pervaded. Nor can any work the destruction of that imperishable One.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: These bodies of the embodied One, who is eternal, indestructible and immeasurable, are known as finite. Therefore fight, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् ।
उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते ॥
iast: ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaścainaṃ manyate hatam ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate ||
verses.english: He who regardeth this as a slayer, and he who thinketh he is slain, both of them are ignorant. He slayeth not, nor is he slain.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः ।
iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadācin nāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ |
ajo nityaḥ śāśvato’ayaṃ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre ||
verses.english: He is not born, nor doth he die; nor having been, ceaseth he any more to be; unborn, perpetual, eternal and ancient, he is not slain when the body is slaughtered.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् ॥
iast: kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṃ ghātayati hanti kam ||
verses.english: Who knoweth him indestructible, perpetual, unborn, undiminishing, how can that man slay, O Pârtha, or cause to be slain?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛhṇāti naro’aparāṇi |
tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇāni anyāni saṃyāti navāni dehī ||
verses.english: As a man, casting off worn-out garments, taketh new ones, so the dweller in the body, casting off worn-out bodies, entereth into others that are new.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः ।
न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः ॥
iast: nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ |
na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ ||
verses.english: Weapons cleave him not, nor fire burneth him, nor waters wet him, nor wind drieth him away.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Uncleavable he, incombustible he, and indeed neither to be wetted nor dried away; perpetual, all-pervasive, stable, immovable, ancient.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Unmanifest, unthinkable, immutable, he is called; therefore knowing him as such, thou shouldst not grieve.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम् ।
iast: atha cainaṃ nityajātaṃ nityaṃ vā manyase mṛtam |
verses.english: Or if thou thinkest of him as being constantly born and constantly dying, even then, O mighty-armed, thou shouldst not grieve.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च ।
iast: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca |
verses.english: For certain is death for the born, and certain is birth for the dead; therefore over the inevitable thou shouldst not grieve.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Beings are unmanifest in their origin, manifest in their midmost state, O Bhârata, unmanifest likewise are they in dissolution. What room then for lamentation?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: āścaryavaccainamanyaḥ śṛṇoti śrutvāpyenaṃ veda na caiva kaścit ||
verses.english: As marvellous one regardeth him; as marvellous another speaketh thereof; as marvellous another heareth thereof; yet having heard none indeed understandeth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: This dweller in the body of everyone is ever invulnerable, O Bhârata; therefore thou shouldst not grieve for any creature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Further, looking to thine own duty thou shouldst not tremble; for there is nothing more welcome to a Kshattriya than righteous war.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Happy the Kshattriyas, O Pârtha, who obtain such a fight, offered unsought as an open door to heaven.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अथ चेत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि ।
ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि ॥
iast: atha cettvamimaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ na kariṣyasi |
tataḥ svadharmaṃ kīrtiṃ ca hitvā pāpamavāpsyasi ||
verses.english: But if thou wilt not carry on this righteous warfare, then casting away thine own duty and thine honour, thou wilt incur sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Men will recount thy perpetual dishonour, and, to one highly esteemed, dishonour exceedeth death.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम् ॥
iast: yeṣāṃ ca tvaṃ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam ||
verses.english: The great car-warriors will think thee fled from the battle from fear, and thou, that wast highly thought of by them, wilt be lightly held.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥
iast: nindantastava sāmarthyaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ||
verses.english: Many unseemly words will be spoken by thine enemies, slandering thy strength; what more painful than that?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम् ।
iast: hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṃ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm |
verses.english: Slain, thou wilt obtain heaven; victorious, thou wilt enjoy the earth; therefore stand up, O son of Kuntî, resolute to fight.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Taking as equal pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, gird thee for the battle; thus thou shalt not incur sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एषा तेऽभिहिता साङ्ख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु ।
बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि ॥
iast: eṣā te’abhihitā sāṅkhye buddhiryoge tvimāṃ śṛṇu |
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṃ prahāsyasi ||
verses.english: This teaching set forth to thee is in accordance with the Sâñkhya ; hear it now according to the Yoga, imbued with which teaching, O Pârtha, thou shalt cast away the bonds of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: In this there is no loss of effort, nor is there transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects from great fear.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The determinate Reason is but one-pointed, O joy of the Kurus; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the irresolute.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Flowery speech is uttered by the foolish, rejoicing in the letter of the Vedas, O Pârtha, saying: "There is naught but this";

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: With desire for self, with heaven for goal, they offer birth as the fruit of action, and prescribe many and various ceremonies for the attainment of pleasure and lordship.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: For them who cling to pleasure and lordship, whose minds are captivated by such teaching, is not designed this determinate Reason, on contemplation steadily bent.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Vedas deal with the three attributes; be thou above these three attributes, O Arjuna; beyond the pairs of opposites, ever steadfast in purity, careless of possessions, full of the Self .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: All the Vedas are as useful to an enlightened Brâhmana as is a tank in a place covered all over with water.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thy business is with the action only, never with its fruits; so let not the fruit of action be thy motive, nor be thou to inaction attached.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
iast: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanañjaya |
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate ||
verses.english: Perform action, O Dhananjaya, dwelling in union with the divine, renouncing attachments and balanced evenly in success and failure: equilibrium is called yoga.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Far lower than the Yoga of Discrimination is action, O Dhananjaya. Take thou refuge in the Pure Reason; pitiable are they who work for fruit.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: United to the Pure Reason one abandoneth here both good and evil deeds; therefore cleave thou to yoga; yoga is skill in action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः ।
iast: karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ |
verses.english: The Sages, united to the Pure Reason, renounce the fruit which action yieldeth, and, liberated from the bonds of birth, they go to the blissful seat.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च ॥
iast: tadā gantāsi nirvedaṃ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca ||
verses.english: When thy mind shall escape from this tangle of delusion, then thou shalt rise to indifference as to what has been heard and shall be heard.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When thy mind, bewildered by the Scriptures, shall stand immovable, fixed in contemplation, then shalt thou attain unto yoga.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम् ॥
iast: sthitadhīḥ kiṃ prabhāṣeta kimāsīta vrajeta kim ||
verses.english: Arjuna said: What the mark, of him who is stable of mind, steadfast in contemplation, O Keshava? How doth the stable-minded talk, how doth he sit, how walk?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: When a man abandoneth, O Pârtha, all the desires of the heart, and is satisfied in the Self by the Self , then is he called stable in mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He whose mind is free from anxiety amid pains, indifferent amid pleasures, loosed from passion, fear and anger, is called a sage of stable mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
iast: nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā ||
verses.english: He who on every side is without attachments, whatever hap of fair and foul, who neither likes nor dislikes, of such a one the understanding is well poised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When, again, as a tortoise draws in on all sides its limbs, he withdraws his senses from the objects of sense, then is his understanding well poised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The objects of sense, but not the relish for them, turn away from an abstemious dweller in the body; and even relish turneth away from him after the Supreme is seen.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: O son of Kuntî, the excited senses of even a wise man, though he be striving, impetuously carry away his mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः ।
वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
iast: tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ |
vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā ||
verses.english: Having restrained them all, he should sit harmonised, I his supreme goal; for, whose senses are mastered, of him the understanding is well poised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Man, musing on the objects of sense, conceiveth an attachment to these; from attachment ariseth desire; from desire anger cometh forth;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: From anger proceedeth delusion; from delusion confused memory; from confused memory the destruction of Reason; from destruction of Reason he perishes.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But the disciplined self, moving among sense-objects with senses free from attraction and repulsion, mastered by the Self, goeth to peace.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: In that Peace the extinction of all pains ariseth for him, for of him whose heart is peaceful the Reason soon attaineth equilibrium.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: There is no Pure Reason for the non-harmonised, nor for the non-harmonised is there concentration; for him without concentration there is no peace, and for the unpeaceful how can there be happiness?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Such of the roving senses as the mind yieldeth to, that hurries away the understanding, just as the gale hurries away a ship upon the waters.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore, O mighty-armed, whose senses are all completely restrained from the objects of sense, of him the understanding is well poised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी ।
यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः ॥
iast: yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī |
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ ||
verses.english: That which is the night of all beings, for the disciplined man is the time of waking; when other beings are waking, then is it night for the sage who seeth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī ||
verses.english: He attaineth Peace, into whom all desires flow as rivers flow into the ocean, which is filled with water, but remaineth unmoved—not he who desireth desires.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whoso forsaketh all desires and goeth onwards free from yearnings, selfless and without egoism—he goeth to Peace.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति ।
iast: eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṃ prāpya vimuhyati |
verses.english: This is the Eternal state, O son of Prithâ. Having attained thereto, none is bewildered. Who, even at the death-hour, is established therein, he goeth to the Nirvâna of the Eternal .

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥
iast: tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava ||
verses.english: Arjuna said: If it be thought by Thee that knowledge is superior to action, O Janârdana, why dost Thou, O Keshava, enjoin on me this terrible action?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: With these perplexing words Thou only confusest my understanding; therefore tell me with certainty the one way by which I may reach bliss.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ ।
iast: loke’asmina dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha |
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: In this world there is a twofold path, as I before said, O sinless one: that of yoga by knowledge, of the Sâñkhyas; and that of yoga by action, of the Yogis.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Man winneth not freedom from action by abstaining from activity, nor by mere renunciation doth he rise to perfection.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Nor can anyone, even for an instant, remain really actionless; for helplessly is everyone driven to action by the qualities born of nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् ।
iast: karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran |
verses.english: Who sitteth, controlling the organs of action, but dwelling in his mind on the objects of the senses, that bewildered man is called a hypocrite.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But who, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, with the organs of action without attachment, performeth yoga by action, he is worthy.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
iast: niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ |
verses.english: Perform thou right action, for, action is superior to inaction, and, inactive, even the maintenance of thy body would not be possible.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The world is bound by action, unless performed for the sake of sacrifice; for that sake, free from attachment, O son of Kuntî, perform thou action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having in ancient times emanated mankind together with sacrifice, the Lord of emanation said: "By this shall ye propagate; be this to you the giver of desire;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "With this nourish ye the Shining Ones, and may the Shining Ones nourish you; thus nourishing one another ye shall reap the supremest good.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः ॥
iast: tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ ||
verses.english: "For, nourished by sacrifice, the Shining Ones shall bestow on you the enjoyments you desire." A thief verily is he who enjoyeth what is given by Them without returning Them aught.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् ॥
iast: bhuñjate te tvaghaṃ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt ||
verses.english: The righteous, who eat the remains of the sacrifice, are freed from all sins; but the impious, who dress food for their own sakes, they verily eat sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: From food creatures become; from rain is the production of food; rain proceedeth from sacrifice; sacrifice ariseth out of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Know thou that from Brahma action groweth, and Brahma from the Imperishable cometh. Therefore the Eternal , the all-permeating, is ever present in sacrifice.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who on earth doth not follow the wheel thus revolving, sinful of life and rejoicing in the senses, he, O son of Pritha, liveth in vain.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते ॥
iast: ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate ||
verses.english: But the man who rejoiceth in the Self , with the Self is satisfied, and is content in the Self , for him verily there is nothing to do;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: For him there is no interest in things done, in this world, nor any in things not done, nor doth any object of his depend on any being.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore, without attachment, constantly perform action which is duty, for, by performing action without attachment, man verily reacheth the Supreme.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Janaka and others indeed attained to perfection by action: then having an eye to the welfare of he world also, thou shouldst perform action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whatsoever a great man doeth, that other men also do; the standard he setteth up, by that the people go.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन ।
iast: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana |
verses.english: There is nothing in the three worlds, O Pârtha, that should be done by Me, nor anything unattained that might be attained; yet I mingle in action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः ।
iast: yadi hyahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ |
verses.english: For if I mingled not ever in action unwearied, men all around would follow My path, O son of Prithâ.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम् ।
iast: utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham |
verses.english: These worlds would fall into ruin, if I did not perform action; I should be the author of confusion of castes, and should destroy these creatures.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As the ignorant act from attachment to action, O Bhârata, so should the wise act without attachment, desiring the welfare of the world.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Let no wise man unsettle the mind of ignorant people attached to action; but acting in harmony with Me let him render all action attractive.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: All actions are wrought by the quali ties of nature only. The self, deluded by egoism, thinketh: "I am the doer."

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते ॥
iast: guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate ||
verses.english: But he, O mighty-armed, who knoweth the essence of the divisions of the qualities and functions, holding that "the qualities move amid the qualities," is not attached.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Those deluded by the qualities of nature are attached to the functions of the qualities. The man of perfect knowledge should not unsettle the foolish whose knowledge is imperfect.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Surrendering all actions to Me, with thy thoughts resting on the supreme Self , from hope and egoism freed, and of mental fever cured, engage in battle.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Who abide ever in this teaching of Mine full of faith and free from caviling, they too are released from actions.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Who carp at My teaching and act not thereon, senseless, deluded in all knowledge, know thou these mindless ones as fated to be destroyed.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति ॥
iast: prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ||
verses.english: Even the man of knowledge behaves in conformity with his own nature; beings follow nature; what shall restraint avail?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Affection and aversion for the objects of sense abide in the senses; let none come under the dominion of these two; they are obstructors of the path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Better one's own duty, though destitute of merit, than the duty of another, well discharged. Better death in the discharge of one's own duty; the duty of another is full of danger.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः ।
iast: atha kena prayukto’ayaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ |
verses.english: Arjuna said: But dragged on by what does a man commit sin, reluctantly indeed, O Varshneya, as it were by force constrained?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: It is desire, it is wrath, begotten by the quality of motion; all-consuming, all-polluting, know thou this as our foe here on earth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As a flame is enveloped by smoke, as a mirror by dust, as an embryo is wrapped by the amnion, so This is enveloped by it.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Enveloped is wisdom by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire, which is insatiable as a flame.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The senses, the mind and the Reason are said to be its seat; by these enveloping wisdom, it bewilders the dweller in the body.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore, O best of the Bhâratas, mastering first the senses, do thou slay this thing of sin, destructive of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः ॥
iast: manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ ||
verses.english: It is said that the senses are great; greater than the senses is the mind: greater than the mind is the Reason; but what is greater than the Reason, is He.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thus understanding Him as greater than the Reason, restraining the self by the Self , slay thou, O mighty-armed, the enemy in the form of desire, difficult to overcome.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: This imperishable yoga I declared to Vivasvân; Vivasvân taught it to Manu; Manu to Ikshvâku told it.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप ॥
iast: sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa ||
verses.english: This, handed on down the line, the King-Sages knew. This yoga by great efflux of time decayed in the world, O Parantapa.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः ।
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ॥
iast: sa evāyaṃ mayā te’adya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ |
bhakto’asi me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam ||
verses.english: This same ancient yoga hath been to-day declared to thee by Me, for thou art My devotee and My friend; it is the supreme Secret.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः ।
iast: aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Later was Thy birth, earlier the birth of Vivasvân; how then am I to understand that Thou declaredst it in the beginning?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन ।
तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप ॥
iast: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna |
tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha parantapa ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Many births have been left behind by Me and by thee, O Arjuna. I know them all, but thou knowest not thine, O Parantapa.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Though unborn, the imperishable Self , and also the Lord of all beings, brooding over nature which is Mine own, yet I am born through My own Power.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata |
verses.english: Whenever there is decay of righteousness, O Bhârata, and there is exaltation of unrighteousness, then I Myself come forth;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: For the protection of the good, for the destruction of evil-doers, for the sake of firmly establishing righteousness, I am born from age to age.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन ॥
iast: janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ |
tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so’arjuna ||
verses.english: He who thus knoweth My divine birth and action, in its essence, having abandoned the body, cometh not to birth again, but cometh unto Me, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Freed from passion, fear and anger, filled with Me, taking refuge in Me, purified in the fire of wisdom, many have entered into My Being.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
iast: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham |
verses.english: However men approach Me, even so do I welcome them, for the path men take from every side is Mine, O Pârtha.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः ।
क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ॥
iast: kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ |
kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā ||
verses.english: They who long after success in action on earth worship the Shining Ones; for in brief space verily, in this world of men, success is born of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The four castes were emanated by Me, by the different distribution of qualities and actions; know Me to be the author of them, though the actionless and inexhaustible.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा ।
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते ॥
iast: na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā |
iti māṃ yo’abhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate ||
verses.english: Nor do actions affect Me, nor is the fruit of action desired by Me. He who thus knoweth Me is not bound by actions.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः ।
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् ॥
iast: evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ |
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam ||
verses.english: Having thus known, our forefathers, ever seeking liberation, performed action; therefore do thou also perform action, as did our forefathers in the olden time.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "What is action, what inaction"? Even the wise are herein perplexed. Therefore I will declare to thee the action by knowing which thou shalt be loosed from evil.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः ।
iast: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ |
verses.english: It is needful to discriminate action, to discriminate unlawful action, and to discriminate inaction; mysterious is the path of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः ।
iast: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ |
verses.english: He who seeth inaction in action, and action in inaction, he is wise among men, he is harmonious, even while performing all action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whose works are all free from the moulding of desire, whose actions are burned up by the fire of wisdom, him the wise have called a Sage.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having abandoned attachment to the fruit of action, always content, nowhere seeking refuge, he is not doing anything, although doing actions.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Hoping for naught, his mind and self controlled, having abandoned all greed, performing action by the body alone, he doth not commit sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते ॥
iast: samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate ||
verses.english: Content with whatsoever he obtaineth without effort, free from the pairs of opposites, without envy, balanced in success and failure, though acting he is not bound.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of one with attachment dead, harmonious, with his thoughts established in wisdom, his works sacrifices, all action melts away.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Eternal the oblation, the Eternal the clarified butter, are offered in the Eternal the fire by the Eternal ; unto the Eternal verily shall he go who in his action meditateth wholly upon the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Some Yogis offer up sacrifice to the Shining Ones; others sacrifice only by pouring sacrifice into the fire of the Eternal ;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Some pour as sacrifice hearing and the other senses into the fires of restraint; some pour sound and the other objects of sense into the fires of the senses as sacrifice;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Others again into the wisdom-kindled fire of union attained by self-control, pour as sacrifice all the functions of the senses and the functions of life;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Yet others the sacrifice of wealth, the sacrifice of austerity, the sacrifice of yoga, the sacrifice of silent reading and wisdom, men concentrated and of effectual vows;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Yet others pour as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming, and the incoming in the outgoing, restraining the flow of the outgoing and incoming breaths, solely absorbed in the control of breathing.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Others regular in food, pour as sacrifice their life-breaths in life-breaths. All these are knowers of sacrifice, and by sacrifice have destroyed their sins.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The eaters of the life-giving remains of sacrifice go to the changeless Eternal . This world is not for the non-sacrificer, much less the other, O best of the Kurus.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे ।
iast: evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe |
verses.english: Many and various sacrifices are thus spread out before the Eternal . Know thou that all these are born of action, and thus knowing thou shalt be free.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Better than the sacrifice of any objects is the sacrifice of wisdom, O Parantapa. All actions in their entirety, O Pârtha, culminate in wisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Learn thou this by discipleship, by investiga tion, and by service. The wise, the seers of the essence of things, will instruct thee in wisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And having known this, thou shalt not again fall into this confusion, O Pândava; for by this thou wilt see all beings without exception in the Self , and thus in Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Even if thou art the most sinful of all sinners, yet shalt thou cross over all sin by the raft of wisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As the burning fire reduces fuel to ashes, O Arjuna, so doth the fire of wisdom reduce all actions to ashes.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
iast: na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate |
verses.english: Verily there is no purifier in this world like wisdom; he that is perfected in yoga finds it in the Self in due season.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The man who is full of faith obtaineth wisdom, and he also who hath mastery over his senses; and, having obtained wisdom, he goeth swiftly to the supreme Peace.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः ॥
iast: nāyaṃ loko’asti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ ||
verses.english: But the ignorant, faithless, doubting self goeth to destruction; nor this world, nor that beyond, nor happiness, is there for the doubting self.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who hath renounced actions by yoga, who hath cloven asunder doubt by wisdom, who is ruled by the Self , actions do not bind him, O Dhananjaya.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore, with the sword of the wisdom of the Self cleaving asunder this ignorance-born doubt dwelling in thy heart, be established in yoga. Stand up, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि ।
iast: saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Renunciation of actions Thou praisest, O Krishna, and then also yoga. Of the two which one is the better? That tell me conclusively.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Renunciation and yoga by action both lead to the highest bliss; of the two, yoga by action is verily better than renunciation of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
iast: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati |
verses.english: He should be known as a perpetual ascetic, who neither hateth nor desireth; free from the pairs of opposites, O mighty-armed, he is easily set free from bondage.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Children, not sages, speak of the Sânkhya and the Yoga as different; he who is duly established in one obtaineth the fruits of both.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एकं साङ्ख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
iast: ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati ||
verses.english: That place which is gained by the Sânkhyas is reached by the Yogîs also. He seeth, who seeth that the Sânkhya and the Yoga are one.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But without yoga, O mighty-armed, renunciation is hard to attain to; the yoga-harmonised Muni swiftly goeth to the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who is harmonised by yoga, the self purified, Self -ruled, the senses subdued, whose Self is the Self of all beings, although acting he is not affected.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "I do not anything," should think the harmonised one, who knoweth the essence of things; seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Speaking, giving, grasping, opening and closing the eyes, he holdeth: "The senses move among the objects of the senses."

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ |
verses.english: He who acteth, placing all actions in the Eternal , abandoning attachment, is unaffected by sin as a lotus leaf by the waters.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Yogis , having abandoned attachment, perform action only by the body, by the mind, by the Reason, and even by the senses, for the purification of the self.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The harmonised man, having abandoned the fruit of action, attaineth to the eternal Peace; the non-harmonised, impelled by desire, attached to fruit, are bound.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ॥
iast: navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan ||
verses.english: Mentally renouncing all actions, the sovereign dweller in the body resteth serenely in the nine-gated city, neither acting nor causing to act.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः ।
iast: na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ |
verses.english: The Lord of the world produceth not the idea of agency, nor actions, nor the union together of action and its fruit; nature, however, manifesteth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः ।
iast: nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ |
verses.english: The Lord accepteth neither the evil-doing nor yet the well-doing of any. Wisdom is enveloped by unwisdom; therewith mortals are deluded.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Verily, in whom unwisdom is destroyed by the wisdom of the Self , in them wisdom, shining as the sun, reveals the Supreme.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thinking on That , merged in That , established in That , solely devoted to That , they go whence there is no return, their sins dispelled by wisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
iast: śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ ||
verses.english: Sages look equally on a Brâhmana adorned with learning and humility, a cow, an elephant, and even a dog and an outcaste.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद् ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ॥
iast: ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ |
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ ||
verses.english: Even here on earth everything is overcome by those whose mind remains balanced; the Eternal is incorruptible and balanced; therefore they are established in the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: With Reason firm, unperplexed, the knower of the Eternal established in the Eternal , neither rejoiceth on obtaining what is pleasant, nor sorroweth on obtaining what is unpleasant.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He, whose self is unattached to external contacts and findeth joy in the Self , having the self harmonised with the Eternal by yoga, enjoys imperishable bliss.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते ।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥
iast: ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te |
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ ||
verses.english: The delights that are contact-born, they are verily wombs of pain, for they have beginning and ending, O Kaunteya; not in them may rejoice the wise.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ॥
iast: kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ ||
verses.english: He who is able to endure here on earth, ere he be liberated from the body, the force born from desire and passion, he is harmonised, he is a happy man.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who is happy within, who rejoiceth within, who is illuminated within, that Yogî, becoming the Eternal , goeth to the Peace of the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Rishis, their sins destroyed, their duality removed, their selves controlled, intent upon the welfare of all beings, obtain the Peace of the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Peace of the Eternal lies near to those who know themselves, who are disjoined from desire and passion, subdued in nature, of subdued thoughts.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having external contacts excluded, and with gaze fixed between the eyebrows; having made equal the outgoing and ingoing breaths moving within the nostrils;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ॥
iast: vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ ||
verses.english: With senses, mind, and Reason ever controlled, solely pursuing liberation, the Sage, having for ever cast away desire, fear and passion, verily is liberated.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having known Me, as the Enjoyer of sacrifice and of austerity, the mighty Ruler of all the worlds, and the Lover of all beings, he goeth to Peace.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः ।
स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥
iast: anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ |
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: He that performeth such action as his duty, independently of the fruit of action, he is an ascetic, he is a Yogî, not he that is without fire, and without rites.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव ।
iast: yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava |
verses.english: That which is called renunciation, know thou that as yoga, O Pândava; nor doth any one become a Yogî with the formative will unrenounced.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: For a Sage who is seeking Yoga, action is called the means; for the same Sage, when he is enthroned in yoga, serenity is called the means.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When a man feeleth no attachment either for the objects of sense or for actions, renouncing the formative will, then, he is said to be enthroned in yoga.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Let him raise the self by the Self and not let the self become depressed; for verily is the Self the friend of the self, and also the Self the self's enemy;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Self is the friend of the self of him in whom the self by the Self is vanquished; but to the unsubdued self the Self verily becometh hostile as an enemy.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The higher Self of him who is Self -controlled and peaceful is uniform in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, as well as in honour and dishonour.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Yogî who is satisfied with wisdom and knowledge, unwavering, whose senses are sub dued, to whom a lump of earth, a stone and gold are the same, is said to be harmonised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who regards impartially lovers, friends, and foes, strangers, neutrals, foreigners and relatives, also the righteous and unrighteous, he excelleth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Let the Yogî constantly engage himself in yoga, remaining in a secret place by himself, with thought and self subdued, free from hope and greed.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: In a pure place, established on a fixed seat of his own, neither very much raised nor very low, made of a cloth, a black antelope skin, and kusha grass, one over the other;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: There, having made the mind one-pointed, with thought and the functions of the senses subdued, steady on his seat, he should practise yoga for the purification of the self.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Holding the body, head and neck erect, immovably steady, looking fixedly at the point of the nose, with unseeing gaze,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
iast: manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ ||
verses.english: The self serene, fearless, firm in the vow of the Brahmachâri, the mind controlled, thinking on Me, harmonised, let him sit aspiring after Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Yogî ever united thus with the Self , with the mind controlled, goeth to Peace, to the supreme Bliss that abideth in Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Verily yoga is not for him who eateth too much, nor who abstaineth to excess, nor who is too much addicted to sleep, nor even to wakefulness, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Yoga killeth out all pain for him who is regulated in eating and amusement, regulated in performing actions, regulated in sleeping and waking.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When his subdued thought is fixed on the Self , free from longing after all desirable things, then it is said, "he is harmonised."

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
iast: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā |
verses.english: As a lamp in a windless place flickereth not, to such is likened the Yogî of subdued thought, absorbed in the yoga of the Self .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That in which the mind finds rest, quieted by the practice of yoga: that in which he, seeing the Self by the Self , in the Self is satisfied;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast: vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ ||
verses.english: That in which he findeth the supreme delight which the Reason can grasp beyond the senses, wherein established he moveth not from the Reality;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
iast: yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ |
verses.english: Which, having obtained, he thinketh there is no greater gain beyond it; wherein, established, he is not shaken even by heavy sorrow;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That should be known by the name of yoga, this disconnection from the union with pain. This yoga must be clung to with a firm conviction and with undesponding mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Abandoning without reserve all desires born of the imagination, by the mind curbing in the aggregate of the senses on every side,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
iast: ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayet ||
verses.english: Little by little let him gain tranquillity, by means of Reason controlled by steadiness; having made the mind abide in the Self , let him not think of anything.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As often as the wavering and unsteady mind goeth forth, so often reining it in, let him bring it under the control of the Self .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Supreme joy is for this Yogi whose mind is peaceful, whose passion-nature is calmed, who is sinless and of the nature of the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Yogî who thus, ever harmonising the self, hath put away sin, he easily enjoyeth the infinite bliss of contact with the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The self, harmonised by yoga, seeth the Self abiding in all beings, all beings in the Self ; everywhere he seeth the same.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
iast: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ||
verses.english: He who seeth Me everywhere, and seeth everything in Me, of him will I never lose hold, and he shall never lose hold of Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
iast: sarvathā vartamāno’api sa yogī mayi vartate ||
verses.english: He who, established in unity, worshippeth Me abiding in all beings, that Yogi liveth in Me, whatever his mode of living.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
iast: sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ ||
verses.english: He who, through the likeness of the Self , O Arjuna, seeth equality in everything, whether pleasant or painful, he is considered a perfect Yogî.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: This yoga which Thou hast declared to be by equanimity, O Madhusûdana, I see not a stable foundation for it, owing to restlessness;

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद् दृढम् ।
iast: cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham |
verses.english: For the mind is verily restless, O Krishna; it is impetuous, strong and difficult to bend. I deem it as hard to curb as the wind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
iast: abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Without doubt, O mighty-armed, the mind is hard to curb and restless; but it may be curbed by constant practice and by dispassion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
iast: asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ |
verses.english: Yoga is hard to attain, methinks, by a self that is uncontrolled; but by the Self -controlled it is attainable by properly directed energy.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
iast: aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati ||
verses.english: Arjuna said: He who is unsubdued but who possesseth faith, with the mind wandering away from yoga, failing to attain perfection in yoga, what path doth he tread, O Krishna?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Fallen from both, is he destroyed like a rent cloud, unsteadfast, O mighty-armed, deluded in the path of the Eternal ?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Deign, O Krishna, to completely dispel this doubt of mine; for there is none to be found save Thyself able to destroy this doubt.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
iast: na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: O son of Prithâ, neither in this world nor in the life to come is there destruction for him; never doth any who worketh righteousness, O beloved, tread the path of woe.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having attained to the worlds of the pure-doing, and having dwelt there for immemorial years, he who fell from yoga is reborn in a pure and blessed house;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Or he may even be born into a family of wise Yogîs; but such a birth as that is most difficult to obtain in this world.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
iast: yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana ||
verses.english: There he recovereth the characteristics belonging to this former body, and with these he again laboureth for perfection, O joy of the Kurus.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: By that former practice he is irresistibly swept away. Only wishing to know yoga, even the seeker after yoga goeth beyond the Brâhmic world;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But the Yogî, labouring with assiduity, purified from sin, fully perfected through manifold births, he reacheth the supreme goal.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Yogî is greater than the ascetics; he is thought to be greater than even the wise; the Yogî is greater than the men of action; therefore become thou a Yogî, O Arjuna!

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
iast: śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ ||
verses.english: And among all Yogîs, he who, full of faith, with the inner Self abiding in Me, adoreth Me, he is considered by Me to be the most completely harmonised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
iast: asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: With the mind clinging to me, O Pârtha, performing yoga, refuged in Me, how thou shalt without doubt know Me to the uttermost, that hear thou.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I will declare to thee this knowledge and wisdom in its completeness, which, having known, there is nothing more here needeth to be known.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Among thousands of men scarce one striveth for perfection; of the successful strivers scarce one knoweth Me in essence.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
iast: bhūmirāpo’analo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca |
verses.english: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, Mind, and Reason also and Egoism—these are the eightfold division of My nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: This the inferior. Know My other nature, the higher, the life-element, O mighty-armed, by which the universe is upheld.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Know this to be the womb of all beings. I am the source of the forthgoing of the whole universe and likewise the place of its dissolving.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
iast: mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||
verses.english: There is naught whatsoever higher than I, O Dhananjaya. All this is threaded on Me, as rows of pearls on a string.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
iast: praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu ||
verses.english: I the sapidity in waters, O son of Kuntî, I the radiance in moon and sun; the Word of Power in all the Vedas, sound in ether, and virility in men;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
iast: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau |
verses.english: The pure fragrance of earths and the bril liance in fire am I; the life in all beings am I, and the austerity in ascetics.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
iast: bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam |
verses.english: Know Me, O Pârtha! as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the Reason of the Reason-endowed, the splendour of splendid things am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And I the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and passion. In beings I am desire not contrary to duty, O Lord of the Bharatas.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
iast: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye |
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi ||
verses.english: The natures that are harmonious, active, slothful, these know as from Me; not I in them, but they in me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: All this world, deluded by these natures made by the three qualities, knoweth not Me, above these, imperishable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
iast: daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā |
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te ||
verses.english: This divine illusion of Mine, caused by the qualities, is hard to pierce; they who come to Me, they cross over this illusion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
iast: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ |
verses.english: The evil-doing, the deluded, the vilest men, they come not to Me, they whose wisdom is destroyed by illusion, who have embraced the nature of demons.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Fourfold in division are the righteous ones who worship me, O Arjuna; the suffering, the seeker for knowledge, the self-interested and the wise, O Lord of the Bhâratas.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
iast: priyo hi jñānino’atyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ ||
verses.english: Of these the wise, constantly harmonised, worshipping the One, is the best; I am supremely dear to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
iast: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam |
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim ||
verses.english: Noble are all these, but I hold the wise as verily Myself; he, Self united, is fixed on Me, the highest Path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: At the close of many births the man full of wisdom cometh unto Me; "Vâsudeva is all." saith he, the Mahâtmâ, very difficult to find.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
iast: taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā ||
verses.english: They whose wisdom hath been rent away by desires go forth to other Shining Ones, resorting to various external observances, according to their own natures.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
iast: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati |
verses.english: Any devotee who seeketh to worship with faith any such aspect, I verily bestow the unswerving faith of that man.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
verses.english: He endowed with that faith, seeketh the worship of such a one, and from him he obtaineth his desires, I verily decreeing the benefits;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Finite indeed the fruit that belongeth to those who are of small intelligence. To the Shining Ones go the worshippers of the Shining Ones, but my devotees come unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Those devoid of Reason think of Me, the unmanifest, as having manifestation, knowing not My supreme nature, imperishable, most excellent.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Nor am I of all discovered, enveloped in My creation-illusion. This deluded world knoweth Me not, the unborn, the imperishable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
iast: bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana ||
verses.english: I know the beings that are past, that are present, that are to come, O Arjuna, but no one knoweth Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, sprung from attraction and repulsion, O Bhârata, all beings walk this universe wholly deluded, O Parantapa.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But those men of pure deeds, in whom sin is come to an end, they, freed from the delusive pairs of opposites, worship Me, steadfast in vows.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
iast: te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam ||
verses.english: They who, refuged in Me, strive for liberation from birth and death, they know the Eternal , the whole Self -knowledge, and all action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
iast: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ |
verses.english: They who know Me as the knowledge of the elements, as that of the Shining Ones, and as that of the Sacrifice, they harmonised in mind, know Me verily even in the time of forthgoing.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
iast: kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama |
verses.english: Arjuna said: What is that Eternal , what Self -knowledge, what Action, O Purushottama? And what is declared to be the knowledge of the Elements, what is called the knowledge of the Shining Ones?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: What is the knowledge of Sacrifice in this body, and how, O, Madhusûdana? And how, at the time of forthgoing art Thou known by the Self -controlled?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: The indestructible, the supreme is the Eternal ; His essential nature is called Self -knowledge; the emanation that causes the birth of beings is named Action;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Knowledge of the Elements concerns My perishable nature, and knowledge of the Shining Ones concerns the life-giving energy; the knowledge of Sacrifice tells of Me, as wearing the body, O best of living beings.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
iast: yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english: And he who, casting off the body, goeth forth thinking upon Me only at the time of the end, he entereth into My being: there is no doubt of that.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
iast: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram |
verses.english: Whosoever at the end abandoneth the body, thinking upon any being, to that being only he goeth, O Kaunteya, ever to that conformed in nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore at all times think upon Me only and fight. With mind and Reason set on Me, without doubt thou shalt come to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: With the mind not wandering after aught else, harmonised by continual practice, constantly meditating, O Pârtha, one goeth to the Spirit supreme, divine.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who thinketh upon the Ancient, the Omniscient, the All-Ruler, minuter than the minute, the supporter of all, of form unimaginable, refulgent as the sun beyond the darkness,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: prayāṇakāle manasā’acalena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva |
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam ||
verses.english: In the time of forthgoing, with unshaken mind, fixed in devotion, by the power of yoga drawing together his life-breath in the centre of the two eyebrows, he goeth to this Spirit, supreme, divine.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ |
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye ||
verses.english: That which is declared indestructible by the Veda-knowers, that which the controlled and passion-free enter, that desiring which Brahmacharya is performed, that path I will declare to thee with brevity.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
iast: sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca |
verses.english: All the gates closed, the mind confined in the heart, the life-breath fixed in his own head, concentrated by yoga,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
iast: yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
verses.english: "Aum!" the one syllabled Eternal , reciting, thinking upon Me, he who goeth forth, abandoning the body, he goeth on the highest path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
iast: ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ |
verses.english: He who constantly thinketh upon Me, not thinking ever of another, of him I am easily reached, O Pârtha, of this ever-harmonised Yogî.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having come to Me, these Mahâtmâs come not again to birth, the place of pain, non-eternal; they have gone to the highest bliss.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
iast: māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate ||
verses.english: The worlds, beginning with the world of Brahmâ, they come and go, O Arjuna; but he who cometh unto Me, O Kaunteya, he knoweth birth no more.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The people who know the day of Brahmâ, a thousand ages in duration, and the night a thousand ages in ending, they know day and night.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: From the unmanifested all the manifested stream forth at the coming of day; at the coming of night they dissolve, even in That called the unmanifested.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
iast: bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate |
verses.english: This multitude of beings, going forth repeatedly, is dissolved at the coming of night: by ordination, O Pârtha, it streams forth at the coming of day.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
iast: yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ||
verses.english: Therefore verily there existeth, higher than that unmanifested, another unmanifested, eternal, which in the destroying of all beings, is not destroyed.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
iast: yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama ||
verses.english: That unmanifested, "the Indestructible," It is called; It is named the highest Path. They who reach It return not. That is My supreme abode.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
iast: puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā |
verses.english: He, the highest Spirit, O Pârtha, may be reached by unswerving devotion to Him alone, in whom all beings abide, by whom all This is pervaded.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast: prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english: That time wherein going forth Yogîs return not, and also that wherein going forth they return, that time shall I declare to thee, O prince of the Bhâratas.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
iast: tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ ||
verses.english: Fire, light, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern path—then, going forth, the men who know the Eternal go to the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Smoke, night-time, the dark fortnight also, the six months of the southern path—then the Yogî, obtaining the moonlight, returneth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
iast: śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate |
verses.english: Light and darkness, these are thought to be the world's everlasting paths; by the one he goeth who returneth not, by the other he who returneth again.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
iast: naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana |
verses.english: Knowing these paths, O Pârtha, the Yogi is nowise perplexed. Therefore in all times be firm in yoga, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam |
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam ||
verses.english: The fruit of meritorious deeds, attached in the Vedas to sacrifices, to austerities, and also to almsgiving, the Yogî passeth all these by having known this, and goeth to the supreme and ancient Seat.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: To thee, the uncarping, verily shall I declare this profoundest Secret, wisdom with knowledge combined, which, having known, thou shalt be freed from evil.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Kingly Science, kingly Secret, supreme Purifier, this; intuitional, according to righteousness, very easy to perform, imperishable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Men without faith in this knowledge, O Parantapa, not reaching Me, return to the paths of this world of death.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: By Me all this world is pervaded in My unmanifested aspect; all beings have root in Me, I am not rooted in them.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
iast: na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram |
verses.english: Nor have beings root in Me; behold My sovereign Yoga! The support of beings, yet not rooted in beings, My Self their efficient cause.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As the mighty air everywhere moving is rooted in the Ether, so all beings rest rooted in Me—thus know thou.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: All beings, O Kaunteya, enter my lower nature at the end of a world-age; at the beginning of a world-age again I emanate them.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
