verses.english: Hidden in Nature, which is mine own, I emanate again and again all this multitude of beings, helpless, by the force of Nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ।
iast: na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya |
verses.english: Nor do these works bind me, O Dhananjaya, enthroned on high unattached to actions.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Under Me as supervisor, Nature sends forth the moving and unmoving: because of this, O Kaunteya, the universe revolves.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The foolish disregard Me, when clad in human semblance, ignorant of My supreme nature, the great Lord of beings;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Empty of hope, empty of deeds, empty of wisdom, senseless, partaking of the deceitful, brutal and demoniacal nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Verily the Mahâtmâs, O Partha, partaking of My divine nature, worship with unwavering mind, having known Me, the imperishable source of beings.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Always magnifying Me, strenuous, firm in vows, prostrating themselves before Me, they worship Me with devotion ever harmonised.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Others also, sacrificing with the sacrifice of wisdom, worship Me as the One and the Manifold everywhere present.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I the ablation; I the sacrifice; I the ancestral offering; I the fire-giving herb; the mantram I; I also the butter; I the fire; the burnt-offering I;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I the Father of this universe, the Mother, the Supporter, the Grandsire, the Holy one to be known, the Word of Power, and also the Rik, Sâma, and Yajur,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
iast: gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt |
verses.english: The Path, Husband, Lord, Witness, Abode, Shelter, Lover, Origin, Dissolution, Foundation, house, Seed imperishable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I give heat; I hold back and send forth the rain; immortality and also death, being and non-being am I, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante |
te puṇyamāsādya surendralokaṃ aśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān ||
verses.english: The knowers of the three, the Soma-drinkers, the purified from sin, worshipping Me with sacrifice, pray of Me the way to heaven; they, ascending to the holy world of the Ruler of the Shining Ones, eat in heaven the divine feasts of the Shining Ones.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti |
verses.english: They, having enjoyed the spacious heaven-world, their holiness withered, come back to this world of death. Following the virtues enjoined by the three, desiring desires, they obtain the transitory.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: To those men who worship Me alone thinking of no other, to those ever harmonious, I bring full security.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Even the devotees of other Shining Ones, who worship full of faith, they also worship Me, O son of Kuntî, though contrary to the ancient rule.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
iast: ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca |
verses.english: I am indeed the enjoyer of all sacrifices and also the Lord, but they know Me not in Essence, and hence they fall.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥
iast: bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino’api mām ||
verses.english: They who worship the Shining Ones go to the Shining Ones; to the Ancestors go the Ancestor-worshippers; to the Elements go those who sacrifice to Elementals; but My worshippers come unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
iast: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati |
verses.english: He who offereth to Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, water, that I accept from the striving self, offered as it is with devotion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whatsoever thou doest, whatsoever thou eatest, whatsoever thou offerest, whatsoever thou givest, whatsoever thou doest of austerity, O Kaunteya, do thou that as an offering unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thus shalt thou be liberated from the bonds of action, yielding good and evil fruits; thyself harmonised by the yoga of renunciation, thou shalt come unto Me when set free.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
iast: samo’ahaṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo’asti na priyaḥ |
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham ||
verses.english: The same am I to all beings; there is none hateful to Me nor dear. They verily who worship Me with devotion, they are in Me, and I also in them.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
iast: sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ ||
verses.english: Even if the most sinful worship Me, with un divided heart, he too must be accounted righteous, for he hath rightly resolved;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
iast: kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati ||
verses.english: Speedily he becometh dutiful and goeth to eternal peace; O Kaunteya, know thou for certain that My devotee perisheth never.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
iast: māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye’api syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ |
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste’api yānti parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english: They who take refuge with Me, O Partha, though of the womb of sin, women, Vaishyas, even Shûdras, they also tread the highest path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: How much rather then holy Brâhmanas and devoted royal saints; having obtained this transient joyless world, worship thou Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
iast: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
verses.english: On Me fix thy mind, be devoted to Me; sacrifice to Me; prostrate thyself before Me; harmonised thus in the Self , thou shalt come unto Me, having Me as thy supreme goal.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
iast: bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed, hear thou My supreme word, that, desiring thy welfare, I will declare to thee who art beloved.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
iast: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ |
verses.english: The multitude of the Shining Ones, or the great Rishis, know not my forthcoming, for I am the beginning of all the Shining Ones and the great Rishis.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who knoweth Me, unborn, beginningless, the great Lord of the world, he among mortals without delusion, is liberated from all sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥
iast: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo’abhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca ||
verses.english: Reason, wisdom, non-illusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, calmness, pleasure, pain, existence, non-existence, fear, and also courage

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
iast: bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
verses.english: Harmlessness, equanimity, content, austerity, almsgiving, fame and obloquy are the various characteristics of beings issuing from Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
iast: madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ ||
verses.english: The seven great Rishis, the ancient Four, and also the Manus, were born of My nature, and mind; of them this race was generated.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
iast: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ |
verses.english: He who knows in essence that sovereignty and yoga of Mine, he is harmonised by unfaltering yoga; there is no doubt thereof.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
iast: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate |
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ ||
verses.english: I am the Generator of all; all evolves from Me; understanding thus, the wise adore Me in rapt emotion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
iast: kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca ||
verses.english: Mindful of Me, their life hidden in Me, illumining each other, ever conversing about Me, they are content and joyful.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
iast: dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te ||
verses.english: To these, ever harmonious, worshipping in love, I give the yoga of discrimination by which they come unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Out of pure compassion for them, dwelling within their Self , I destroy the ignorance-born darkness by the shining lamp of wisdom.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
iast: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Thou art the supreme Eternal , the supreme Abode, the supreme Purity, eternal divine man, primeval Deity, unborn, the Lord!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
iast: asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me ||
verses.english: All the Rishis have thus acclaimed Thee, as also the divine Rishi, Nârada; so Asita, Devala, and Vyâsa; and now Thou Thyself tellest it me.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
iast: na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ ||
verses.english: All this I believe true that Thou sayest to me, O Keshava. Thy manifestation, O Blessed Lord, neither Shining Ones nor Dânavas comprehend.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Thyself indeed knowest Thyself by Thyself, O Purushottama; Source of beings, Lord of beings, Shining One of Shining Ones, Ruler of the world!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Deign to tell without reserve of Thine own divine glories, by which glories Thou remainest, pervading these worlds.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
iast: keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo’asi bhagavanmayā ||
verses.english: How may I know thee, O Yogi, by constant meditation? In what, in what aspects art Thou to be thought of by me, O blessed Lord?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
iast: bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me’amṛtam ||
verses.english: In detail tell me again of Thy yoga and glory, O Janardana; for me there is never satiety in hearing thy life-giving words.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Blessed be thou! I will declare to thee My divine glory by its chief characteristics, O best of the Kurus; there is no end to details of Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
iast: ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca ||
verses.english: I, O Gudakesha, am the Self , seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle, and also the end of all beings.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of the Adityas I am Vishnu; of radiances the glorious sun; I am Marîchi of the Maruts; of the asterisms the Moon am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of the Vedas I am the Sâma-Veda; I am Vâsava of the Shining Ones; and of the senses I am the mind; I am of living beings the intelligence.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And of the Rudras Shañkara am I; Vittesha of the Yakshas and Râkshasas; and of the Vasus I am Pâvaka; Meru of high mountains am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
iast: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim |
verses.english: And know Me, O Pârtha, of household priests the chief, Brihaspati: of generals I am Skanda; of lakes I am the ocean.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of the great Rishis Bhṛigu; of speech I am the one syllable; of sacrifices I am the sacrifice of silent repetitions; of immovable things the Himâlaya.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Asvattha of all tree; and of divine Rishis Nârada; of Gandharvas Chitraratha; of the perfected the Muni Kapila.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Uchchaishravas of horses know me, nectar-born; Airâvata of lordly elephants, and of men the Monarch.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt; of cows I am Kâmadhuk; I am Kandarpa of the progenitors; of serpents Vâsuki am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And I am Ananta of Nâgas, Varuna of sea-dwellers I; and of ancestors Aryaman; Yama of governors am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And I am Prahlâda of Daityas; of calculators Time am I; and of wild beasts I the imperial beast; and Vainateya of birds.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of purifiers I am the wind; Rama of warriors I; and I am Makara of fishes; of streams the Gangâ am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of creations the beginning and the ending, and also the middle am I, O Arjuna. Of sciences the science concerning the Self ; the speech of orators I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of letters the letter A I am, and the duality of a compound; I also everlasting Time; I the Supporter, whose face turns everywhere.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
iast: kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ||
verses.english: And all-devouring Death am I, and the origin of all to come; and of feminine qualities, fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, constancy, forgiveness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of hymns also Brihatsâman; Gâyatrî of metres am I; of months I am Mârgasîrsha; of seasons the flowery.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I am the gambling of the cheat, and the splendour of splendid things I; I am victory, I am determination, and the truth of the truthful I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of the Vṛishnis Vâsudeva am I; of the Pândavas Dhananjaya; of the Sages also I am Vyâsa; of poets Ushanâ the Bard.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of rulers I am the sceptre; of those that seek victory I am statesmanship; and of secrets I am also silence; the knowledge of knowers am I.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
iast: na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram ||
verses.english: And whatsoever is the seed of all beings, that am I, O Arjuna; nor is there aught, moving or unmoving, that may exist bereft of Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: There is no end of My divine powers, O Parantapa. What has been declared is illustrative of My infinite glory.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whatsoever is glorious, good, beautiful, and mighty, understand thou that to go forth from a fragment of My splendour.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But what is the knowledge of all these details to thee, O Arjuna? Having pervaded this whole universe with one fragment of Myself, I remain.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Arjuna said: This word of the supreme Secret concerning the Self, Thou hast spoken out of compassion; by this my delusion is taken away.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
iast: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā |
verses.english: The production and destruction of beings have been heard by me in detail from Thee, O Lotus-eyed, and also Thy imperishable greatness.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: O supreme Lord, even as Thou describest Thyself, O best of beings, I desire to see Thy Form omnipotent.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
iast: manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho |
verses.english: If Thou thinkest that by me It can be seen, O Lord, Lord of Yoga, then show me Thine imperishable Self.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
iast: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo’atha sahasraśaḥ |
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Behold, O Pârtha, a Form of Me, a hundredfold, a thousandfold, various in kind, divine, various in colours and shapes.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Behold the Âdityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins and also the Maruts; behold many marvels never seen ere this, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Here, to-day, behold the whole universe, movable and immovable, standing in one in My body, O Gudâkesha, with aught else thou desirest to see.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥
iast: na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā |
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram ||
verses.english: But verily thou art not able to behold Me with these thine eyes; the divine eye I give unto thee. Behold My sovereign Yoga.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Having thus spoken, O King, the great Lord of Yoga, Hari, showed to Pârtha His supreme Form as Lord.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: With many mouths and eyes, with many visions of marvel, with many divine ornaments, with many upraised divine weapons;

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Wearing divine necklaces and vestures, anointed with divine unguents, the God all-marvellous, boundless, with face turned everywhere.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
iast: yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ ||
verses.english: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to blaze out together in the sky, that might resemble the glory of that Mahâtman.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: There Pândava beheld the whole universe, divided into manifold parts, standing in one in the body of the Deity of Deities.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Then he, Dhananjaya, overwhelmed with astonishment, his hair upstanding, bowed down his head to the Shining One, and with joined palms spake.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Within Thy Form, O God, the Gods I see, All grades of beings with distinctive marks; Brahma, the Lord, upon His lotus-throne, The Rishis all, and Serpents, the Divine.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa ||
verses.english: With mouths, eyes, arms, breasts multitudinous, I see Thee everywhere, unbounded Form. Beginning, middle, end, nor source of Thee, Infinite Lord, infinite Form, I find;

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam |
verses.english: Shining, a mass of splendour everywhere, With discus, mace, tiara, I behold: Blazing as fire, as sun dazzling the gaze, From all sides in the sky, immeasurable.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam |
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me ||
verses.english: Lofty beyond all thought, unperishing, Thou treasure-house supreme, all-immanent; Eternal Dharma's changeless Guardian, Thou; As immemorial Man I think of Thee.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam ||
verses.english: Nor source, nor midst, nor end; infinite force, Unnumbered arms, the sun and moon Thine eyes I see Thy face, as sacrificial fire Blazing, its splendour burneth up the worlds.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ |
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman ||
verses.english: By Thee alone are filled the earth, the heavens, And all the regions that are stretched between; The triple worlds sink down, O mighty One, Before Thine awful manifested Form.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: amī hi tvāṃ surasaṅghā viśanti kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti |
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ ||
verses.english: To Thee the troops of Suras enter in, Some with joined palms in awe invoking Thee; Banded Maharshis, Siddhas, cry: "All hail"! Chanting Thy praises with resounding songs.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve’aśvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca |
verses.english: Rudras, Vasus, Sâdhyas and Adityas, Vishvas, the Ashvins, Maruts, Ushmapas, Gandharvas, Yakshas, Siddhas, Asuras, In wondering multitudes beholding Thee.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Thy mighty Form, with many mouths and eyes, Long armed, with thighs and feet innumerate, Vast-bosomed, set with many fearful teeth, The worlds see terror-struck, as also I.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
iast: dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo ||
verses.english: Radiant, Thou touchest heaven, rainbow-hued, With opened mouths and shining vast-orbed eyes. My inmost self is quaking, having seen, My strength is withered, Vishnu, and my peace.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
iast: daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni |
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa ||
verses.english: Like Time's destroying flames I see Thy teeth, Upstanding, spread within expanded jaws; Nought know I anywhere, no shelter find; Mercy, O God! re of all the worlds!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ |
verses.english: The sons of Dhṛitarâshtra, and with them The multitude of all these kings of earth, Bhîshma, and Drona, Sûta's royal son, And all the noblest warriors of our hosts,

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni |
verses.english: Into Thy gaping mouths they hurrying rush, Tremendous-toothed and terrible to see; Some caught within the gaps between Thy teeth Are seen, their heads to powder crushed and ground.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: As river-floods impetuously rush, Hurling their waters into ocean's lap, So fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths, In haste, these mighty men, these lords of earth.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ |
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokāsa- tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ ||
verses.english: As moths with quickened speed will headlong fly Into a flaming light, to fall destroyed, So also these, in haste precipitate, Enter within Thy mouths destroyed to fall.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: On every side, all-swallowing, fiery-tongued, Thou lickest up mankind, devouring all; The glory filleth space: the universe Is burning, Vishnu, with Thy blazing rays.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo namo’astu te devavara prasīda |
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim ||
verses.english: Reveal Thy Self ; what awful Form art Thou? I worship Thee! Have mercy, God supreme! Thine inner Being I am fain to know; This Thy forth-streaming Life bewilders me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: ṛte’api tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye’avasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ ||
verses.english: Time am I, laying desolate the world, Made manifest on earth to slay mankind! Not one of all these warriors ranged for strife Escapeth death; thou shalt alone survive.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham |
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin ||
verses.english: Therefore stand up! win for thyself renown, Conquer thy foes, enjoy the wealth filled realm, By Me they are already overcome, Be thou the outward cause, left-handed one.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
iast: droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca karṇaṃ tathānyānapi yodhavīrān |
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi mavyathiṣṭhā yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān ||
verses.english: Drona and Bhîshma and Jayadratha, Karna, and all the other warriors here, Are slain by Me. Destroy them fearlessly. Fight! thou shalt crush thy rivals in the field.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
iast: namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya ||
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Having heard these words of Keshava, he who weareth a diadem, with joined palms, quaking and prostrating himself, spake again to Krishna, stammering with fear, casting down his face.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca |
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ ||
verses.english: Arjuna said: Hrishîkesha! in Thy magnificence Rightly the world rejoiceth, hymning Thee; The Râkshasas to every quarter fly In fear; the hosts of Siddhas prostrate fall.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: kasmācca te na nameranmahātman garīyase brahmaṇo’apyādikartre |
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat ||
verses.english: How should they otherwise, O loftiest Self! First Cause! Brahmâ Himself less great than Thou. Infinite, God of Gods, home of all worlds, Unperishing, Sat, Asat, That supreme!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
iast: tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇasa- tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam |
vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa ||
verses.english: First of the Gods, most ancient Man Thou art. Supreme receptacle of all that lives; Knower and known, the dwelling-place on high; In Thy vast Form the universe is spread.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: namo namaste’astu sahasrakṛtvaḥ punaśca bhūyo’api namo namaste ||
verses.english: Thou art Vâyu and Yama, Agni, moon, Varuna, Father, Grandsire of all; Hail, hail to Thee! a thousand times all hail! Hail unto Thee! again, again all hail!

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste namo’astu te sarvata eva sarva |
verses.english: Prostrate in front of Thee, prostrate behind; Prostrate on every side to Thee, O All. In power boundless, measureless in strength, Thou holdest all: then Thou Thyself art All.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
iast: sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti |
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi ||
verses.english: If, thinking Thee but friend, importunate, O Krishna! or O Yâdava! O friend! I cried, unknowing of Thy majesty, And careless in the fondness of my love;

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: If jesting I irreverence showed to Thee, At play, reposing, sitting or at meals, Alone, O sinless One, or with my friends, Forgive my error, O Thou boundless One.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān |
verses.english: Father of worlds, of all that moves and stands, Worthier of reverence than the Guru's self, There is none like to Thee. Who passeth Thee? Pre-eminent Thy power in all the worlds.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum ||
verses.english: Therefore I fall before Thee; with my body I worship as it fitting; bless Thou me. As father with the son, as friend with friend, With the beloved as lover, bear with me.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito’asmi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me |
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa ||
verses.english: I have seen that which none hath seen before, My heart is glad, yet faileth me for fear; Show me, O God, Thine other Form again— Mercy, O God of Gods, home of all worlds—

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
iast: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahastaṃ icchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva |
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte ||
verses.english: Diademed, mace and discus in Thy hand. Again I fain would see Thee as before; Put on again Thy four-armed shape, O Lord, O thousand-armed, of forms innumerate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt |
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Arjuna, by My favour thou hast seen, This loftiest Form by yoga's self revealed! Radiant, all-penetrating, endless, first, That none except thyself hath ever seen.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānaira- na ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ |
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra ||
verses.english: Nor sacrifice, nor Vedas, alms, nor works, Nor sharp austerity, nor study deep, Can win the vision of this Form for man, Foremost of Kurus, thou alone hast seen.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
iast: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam |
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya ||
verses.english: Be not bewildered, be thou not afraid, Because thou hast beheld this awful Form; Cast fear away, and let thy heart rejoice; Behold again Mine own familiar shape.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
iast: ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ |
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā ||
verses.english: Sanjaya said: Vâsudeva, having thus spoken to Arjuna, again manifested His own Form, and consoled the terrified one, the Mahâtman again assuming a gentle form.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन ।
iast: dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Beholding again Thy gentle human Form, O Janârdana, I am now collected, and am restored to my own nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: This Form of Mine beholden by thee is very hard to see. Verily the Shining Ones ever long to behold this form.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥
iast: nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā |
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā ||
verses.english: Nor can I be seen as thou hast seen Me by the Vedas, nor by austerities, nor by alms, or by offerings;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप ॥
iast: jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca parantapa ||
verses.english: But by devotion to Me alone I may thus be perceived, Arjuna, and known and seen in essence, and entered, O Parantapa.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
iast: nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava ||
verses.english: He who doeth actions for Me, whose supreme good I am, My devotee, freed from attachment without hatred of any being, he cometh unto Me, O Pândava.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Arjuna said: Those devotees who ever harmonised worship Thee, and those also who worship the Indestructible, the Unmanifested, whether of these is the more learned in yoga?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
iast: mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate |
śraddhayā parayopetāḥ te me yuktatamā matāḥ ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: They who with mind fixed on Me ever harmonised worship Me, with faith supreme endowed, these, in My opinion, are best in yoga.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: They who worship the Indestructible, the Ineffable, the unmanifested, Omnipresent, and Unthinkable, the Unchanging, Immutable, Eternal,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Restraining and subduing the senses, regarding everything equally, in the welfare of all rejoicing, these also come unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The difficulty of those whose minds are set on the Unmanifested is greater; for the path of the Unmanifested is hard for the embodied to reach.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः ।
iast: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ |
verses.english: Those verily who, renouncing all actions in Me and intent on Me, worship meditating on Me, with whole-hearted yoga,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: These I speedily lift up from the ocean of death and existence, O Pârtha, their minds being fixed on Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय ।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥
iast: mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya |
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english: Place thy mind in me, into Me let thy Reason enter; then without doubt thou shalt abide in Me hereafter.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् ।
iast: atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram |
verses.english: And if thou art not able firmly to fix thy mind on Me, then by the yoga of practice seek to reach Me, O Dhananjaya.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: If also thou art not equal to constant practice, be intent on My service; performing actions for My sake, thou shalt attain perfection.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: If even to do this thou hast not strength, then, taking refuge in union with Me, renounce all fruit of action with the self controlled.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Better indeed is wisdom than constant-practice; than wisdom, meditation is better; than meditation, renunciation of the fruit of action; on renunciation follows peace.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
iast: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca |
verses.english: He who beareth no ill-will to any being, friendly and compassionate, without attachment and egoism, balanced in pleasure and pain, and forgiving,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Ever content, harmonious, with the self-controlled, resolute, with mind and Reason dedicated to Me, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥
iast: harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||
verses.english: He from whom the world doth not shrink away, who doth not shrink away from the world, freed from the anxieties of joy, anger, and fear, he is dear to me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
iast: sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ ||
verses.english: He who wants nothing, is pure, expert, passionless, untroubled, renouncing every undertaking, he, My devotee, is dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
iast: yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
verses.english: He who neither loveth nor hateth, nor grieveth, nor desireth, renouncing good and evil, full of devotion, he is dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः ।
iast: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ |
verses.english: Alike to foe and friend, and also in fame and ignominy, alike in cold and heat, pleasures and pains, destitute of attachment,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Taking equally praise and reproach, silent, wholly content with what cometh, homeless, firm in mind, full of devotion, that man is dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: They verily who partake of this life-giving wisdom as taught herein, endued with faith, I their supreme Object, devotees, they are surpassingly dear to Me.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च ।
iast: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca |
verses.english: Arjuna said: Matter and Spirit, even the Field and the Knower of the Field, wisdom and that which ought to be known, these I fain would learn, O Keshava.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥
iast: etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: This body, son of Kuntî, is called the Field; that which knoweth it is called the Knower of the Field by the Sages.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत ।
iast: kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata |
verses.english: Understand Me as the Knower of the Field in all Fields, O Bhârata. Wisdom as to the Field and the Knower of the Field, that in My opinion is the wisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥
iast: tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛkca yadvikāri yataśca yat |
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu ||
verses.english: What that Field is and of what nature, how modified, and whence it is, and what He is and what His powers, hear that now briefly from Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Rishis have sung in manifold ways, in many various chants, and in decisive Brahma-sûtra verses full of reasonings.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The great Elements, Individuality, Reason, and also the unmanifested, the ten senses and the one, and the five pastures of the senses;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
iast: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ |
verses.english: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, combination, intelligence, firmness; these, briefly described, constitute the Field and its modifications.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Humility, unpretentiousness, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service of the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-control.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Dispassion towards the objects of the senses, and also absence of egoism, insight into the pain and evil of birth, death, old age and sickness,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Unattachment, absence of self-identification with son, wife or home, and constant balance of mind in wished-for and unwished-for events,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Unflinching devotion to Me by yoga, without other objects, resort to sequestered places, absence of enjoyment in the company of men,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Constancy in the wisdom of the Self, understanding of the object of essential wisdom; that is declared to be the Wisdom; all against it is ignorance.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I will declare that which ought to be known, that which being known immortality is enjoyed—the beginningless supreme Eternal , called neither being nor non-being.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Everywhere That hath hands and feet, everywhere eyes, heads, and mouths; all-hearing, He dwelleth in the world, enveloping all,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Shining with all sense-faculties without any senses; unattached supporting everything and free from qualities enjoying qualities;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Without and within all beings, immovable and also movable; by reason of His subtlety imperceptible; at hand and far away is That .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
iast: avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam |
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca ||
verses.english: Not divided amid beings, and yet seated distributively; that is to be known as the supporter of beings; He devours and He generates.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥
iast: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam ||
verses.english: That , the Light of all lights, is said to be beyond darkness; Wisdom, the Object of Wisdom, by Wisdom to be reached, seated in the hearts of all.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
iast: iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ |
verses.english: Thus the Field, Wisdom and the Object of Wisdom, have been briefly told. My devotee, thus knowing, enters into My Being.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Know thou that Matter and Spirit are both without beginning; and know thou also that modifications and qualities are all Matter-born.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Matter is called the cause of the generation of causes and effects; Spirit is called the cause of the enjoyment of pleasure and pain.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Spirit seated in Matter useth the qualities born of Matter; attachment to the qualities is the cause of his births in good and evil wombs.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Supervisor and permitter, supporter, enjoyer, the great Lord, and also the supreme Self ; thus is styled in this body the supreme Spirit.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
iast: ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha |
verses.english: He who thus knoweth Spirit and Matter with its qualities, in whatsoever condition he may be, he shall not be born again.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Some by meditation behold the Self in the self by the Self ; others by the Sânkhya Yoga, and others by the Yoga of Action;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Others also, ignorant of this, having heard of it from others, worship; and these also cross beyond death, adhering to what they had heard.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Whatsoever creature is born immobile or mobile, know thou, O best of the Bhâratas, that it is from the union between the Field and the Knower of the Field.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Seated equally in all beings, the supreme Lord, unperishing within the perishing—he who thus seeth, he seeth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
iast: na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english: Seeing indeed everywhere the same Lord equally dwelling, he doth not destroy the Self , and thus treads the highest Path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who seeth that Matter verily performeth all actions, and that the Self is actionless, he seeth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा ॥
iast: tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā ||
verses.english: When he perceiveth the diversified existence of beings as rooted in One, and spreading forth from it, then he reacheth the Eternal

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥
iast: śarīrastho’api kaunteya na karoti na lipyate ||
verses.english: Being beginningless and without qualities, the imperishable supreme Self , though seated in the body, O Kaunteya, worketh not nor is affected.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: As the omnipresent ether is not affected, by reason of its subtlety, so seated everywhere in the body the Self is not affected.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥
iast: kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata ||
verses.english: As the one sun illumineth the whole earth, so the Lord of the Field illumineth the whole Field, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥
iast: bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param ||
verses.english: They who by the eyes of Wisdom perceive this difference between the Field and the Knower of the Field, and the liberation of beings from Matter they go to the Supreme.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥
iast: yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: I will again proclaim that supreme Wisdom, of all wisdom the best, which having known, all the Sages have gone hence to the supreme Perfection.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
iast: sarge’api nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca ||
verses.english: Having taken refuge in this Wisdom and being assimilated to My own nature, they are not re-born even in the emanation of a universe, nor are disquieted in the dissolution.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: My womb is the great Eternal ; in that I place the germ; thence cometh the birth of all beings, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: In whatsoever wombs mortals are produced, O Kaunteya, the great Eternal is their womb, I their generating father.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Harmony, Motion, Inertia, such are the qualities, Matter-born; they bind fast in the body, O great-armed one, the indestructible dweller in the body.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of these Harmony from its stainlessness, luminous and healthy, bindeth by the attachment to bliss and the attachment to wisdom, O sinless one.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Motion, the passion nature, know thou, is the source of attachment and thirst for life, O Kaunteya, that bindeth the dweller in the body by the attachment to action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: But Inertia, know thou, born of unwisdom, is the deluder of all dwellers in the body; that bindeth by heedlessness, indolence and sloth, O Bharata .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत ।
iast: sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata |
verses.english: Harmony attacheth to bliss, Motion to action O Bharata . Inertia, verily, having shrouded wisdom, attacheth on the contrary to heedlessness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥
iast: rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā ||
verses.english: Now Harmony prevaileth, having overpowered Motion and Inertia, O Bhârata; now Motion, having overpowered Harmony and Inertia; and now Inertia, having overpowered Harmony and Motion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When the wisdom-light streameth forth from all the gates of the body, then it may be known that Harmony is increasing.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Greed, outgoing energy, undertaking of actions, restlessness, desire—these are born of the increase of Motion, O best of the Bhâratas.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Darkness, stagnation and heedlessness and also delusion—these are born of the increase of Inertia, O joy of the Kurus.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
iast: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt |
verses.english: If Harmony verily prevaileth when the embodied goeth to dissolution, then he goeth forth to the spotless worlds of the great Sages.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Having gone to dissolution in Motion, he is born among those attached to action; if dissolved in Inertia, he is born in the wombs of the senseless.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: It is said the fruit of a good action is harmonious and spotless; verily the fruit of Motion is pain, and the fruit of Inertia unwisdom

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
iast: sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca |
verses.english: From Harmony wisdom is born, and also greed from Motion; heedlessness and delusion are of Inertia and also unwisdom.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
iast: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ |
verses.english: They rise upwards who are settled in Harmony; the Active dwell in the mid-most place: the Inert go downwards, enveloped in the vilest

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When the Seer perceiveth no agent other than the qualities, and knoweth That which is higher than the qualities, he entereth into My Nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When the dweller in the body hath crossed over these three qualities, whence all bodies have been produced, liberated from birth, death, old age and sorrow, he drinketh the nectar of immortality.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Arjuna said: What are the marks of him who hath crossed over the three qualities, O Lord? How acteth he, and how doth he go beyond these three qualities?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥
iast: prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava |
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: He, O Pândava, who hateth not radiance, nor outgoing energy, nor even delusion, when present, nor longeth after them, absent;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who, seated as a neutral, is unshaken by the qualities; who, saying, "The qualities revolve," standeth apart immovable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Balanced in pleasure and pain, self-reliant, to whom a lump of earth, a rock and gold are alike, the same to loved and unloved, firm, the same in censure and in praise,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The same in honour and ignominy, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings—he is said to have crossed over the qualities.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: And he who serveth Me exclusively by the Yoga of devotion, he, crossing beyond the qualities, he is fit to become the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: For I am the abode of the Eternal , and of the indestructible nectar of immortality, of immemorial righteousness, and of unending bliss.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥
iast: chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: With roots above, branches below, the Asvattha is said to be indestructible; the leaves of it are hymns; he who knoweth it is a Veda-knower.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Downwards and upwards spread the branches of it, nourished by the qualities; the objects of the senses its buds; and its roots grow downwards, the bonds of action in the world of men.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca sampratiṣṭhā |
verses.english: Nor here may be acquired knowledge of its form, nor its end, nor its origin, nor its rooting-place; this strongly rooted Asvattha having been cut down by the unswerving weapon of non-attachment,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ |
verses.english: That path beyond may be sought, treading which there is no return. I go indeed to that Primal Man, whence the ancient energy forth-streamed.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Without pride and delusion, victorious over the vice of attachment, dwelling constantly in the Self , desire pacified, liberated from the pairs of opposites known as pleasure and pain, they tread, undeluded, that indestructible path.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः ।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
iast: na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ |
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama ||
verses.english: Nor doth the sun lighten there, nor moon, nor fire; having gone thither they return not; that is My supreme abode.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: A portion of Mine own Self, transformed in the world of life into an immortal Spirit, draweth round itself the senses of which the mind is the sixth, veiled in matter.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: When the Lord acquireth a body and when He abandoneth it, He seizeth these and goeth with them, as the wind takes fragrances from their retreats

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च ।
iast: śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca |
verses.english: Enshrined in the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste and the smell, and in the mind also, He enjoyeth the objects of the senses

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् ।
iast: utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam |
verses.english: The deluded do not perceive (Him) when He departeth or stayeth or enjoyeth, swayed by the qualities; the wisdom-eyed perceive.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Yogîs also, struggling, perceive Him, established in the Self ; but though struggling, the unintelligent perceive Him not, their selves untrained.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That splendour issuing from the sun that enlighteneth the whole world, that which is in the moon and in fire, that splendour know as from Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥
iast: puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ ||
verses.english: Permeating the soil, I support beings by my vital energy, and having become the delicious Soma I nourish all plants.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: I, having become the Fire of Life, take possession of the bodies of breathing things, and united with the life-breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
iast: sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanañca |
verses.english: And I am seated in the hearts of all, and from Me memory and wisdom and their absence. And that which is to be known in all the Vedas am I; and I indeed the Veda-knower and the author of the Vedanta.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च ।
iast: dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca |
verses.english: There are two Energies in this world, the destructible and the indestructible; the destructible is all beings, the unchanging is called the indestructible.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The highest Energy is verily Another, declared as the Supreme Self , He who, pervading all, sustaineth the three worlds, the indestructible Lord.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.english: Since I excel the destructible, and am more excellent also than the indestructible, in the world and in the Veda I am proclaimed the Supreme Spirit.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who undeluded knoweth Me thus as the Supreme Spirit, he, all-knowing, worshippeth Me with his whole being, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thus by Me this most secret teaching hath been told O sinless one. This known, he hath become illuminated and hath finished his work, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Fearlessness, cleanness of life, steadfastness in the Yoga of wisdom, almsgiving, self-restraint and sacrifice and study of the Scriptures, austerity and straightforwardness,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, peacefulness, absence of crookedness, compassion to living beings, uncovetousness, mildness, modesty, absence of fickleness,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Vigour, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of envy and pride—these are his who is born with the divine properties, O Bhârata.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Hypocrisy, arrogance and conceit, wrath and also harshness and unwisdom are his who is born, O Pârtha, with demoniacal properties.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The divine properties are deemed to be for liberation, the demoniacal for bondage. Grieve not, thou art born with divine properties, O Pândava.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
iast: dvau bhūtasargau loke’asmindaiva āsura eva ca |
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu ||
verses.english: Twofold is the animal creation in this world, the divine and the demoniacal: the divine hath been described at length: hear from Me, O Pârtha, the demoniacal.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
iast: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ |
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate ||
verses.english: Demoniacal men know neither right energy nor right abstinence; nor purity, nor even propriety, nor truth is in them.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "The universe is without truth, without basis," they say, "without a God; brought about by mutual union, and caused by lust and nothing else."

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Holding this view, these ruined selves of small understanding, of fierce deeds, come forth as enemies for the destruction of the world.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Surrendering themselves to insatiable desires, possessed with vanity, conceit and arrogance, holding evil ideas through delusion, they engage in action with impure resolves.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Giving themselves over to unmeasured thought whose end is death, regarding the gratification of desires as the highest, feeling sure that this is all,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Held in bondage by a hundred ties of expectation, given over to lust and anger, they strive to obtain by unlawful means hoards of wealth for sensual enjoyments.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "This to-day by me hath been won, that purpose I shall gain; this wealth is mine already, and also this shall be mine in future.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "I have slain this enemy, and others also I shall slay. I am the Lord, I am the enjoyer, I am perfect, powerful, happy;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "I am wealthy, well-born; what other is there that is like unto me? I will sacrifice, I will give alms, I will rejoice." Thus deluded by unwisdom,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Bewildered by numerous thoughts, enmeshed in the web of delusion, addicted to the gratification of desire, they fall downwards into a foul hell.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Self-glorifying, stubborn, filled with the pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform lip-sacrifices for ostentation, contrary to scriptural ordinance.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
iast: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ |
verses.english: Given over to egoism, power, insolence, lust and wrath, these malicious ones hate Me in the bodies of others and in their own.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: These haters, evil, pitiless, vilest among men in the world, I ever throw down into demoniacal wombs.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Cast into demoniacal wombs, deluded birth after birth, attaining not to Me, O Kaunteya, they sink into the lowest depths.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Triple is the gate of this hell, destructive of the self—lust, wrath, and greed; therefore let man renounce these three.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: A man liberated from these three gates of darkness, O son of Kunti, accomplisheth his own welfare, and thus reacheth the highest goal.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥
iast: na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim ||
verses.english: He who, having cast aside the ordinances of the Scriptures, followeth the promptings of desire, attaineth not to perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore let the Scriptures be thy authority, in determining what ought to be done, or what ought not to be done. Knowing what hath been declared by the ordinances of the Scriptures, thou oughtest to work in this world.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
deva: तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः ॥
iast: teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ ||
verses.english: Arjuna said: Those that sacrifice full of faith, but casting aside the ordinances of the Scriptures, what is verily their condition, O Krishna? Is it one of Purity, Passion, or Darkness?

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा ।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु ॥
iast: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā |
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu ||
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Threefold is by nature the inborn faith of the embodied—pure, passionate, and dark. Hear thou of these.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥
iast: śraddhāmayo’ayaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ||
verses.english: The faith of each is shaped to his own nature, O Bhârata. The man consists of his faith; that which his faith is, he is even that.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Pure men worship the Gods; the passionate the gnomes and giants; the others, the dark folk, worship ghosts and troops of nature-spirits.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः ।
iast: aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ |
verses.english: The men who perform severe austerities, unenjoined by the Scriptures, wedded to vanity and egoism, impelled by the force of their desires and passions,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Unintelligent, tormenting the aggregated elements forming the body, and Me also, seated in the inner body, know these demoniacal in their resolves.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The food also which is dear to each is threefold, as also sacrifice, austerity and almsgiving. Hear thou the distinction of these.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः ॥
iast: rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ ||
verses.english: The foods that augment vitality, energy, vigour, health, joy and cheerfulness, delicious, bland, substantial and agreeable, are dear to the pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The passionate desire foods that are bitter, sour, saline, over-hot, pungent, dry and burning and which produce pain, grief and sickness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् ।
iast: yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
verses.english: That which is stale and flat, putrid and corrupt, leavings also and unclean, is the food dear to the dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The sacrifice which is offered by men without desire for fruit, as enjoined by the ordinances, under the firm belief that sacrifice is a duty, that is pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अभिसन्धाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत् ।
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
iast: abhisandhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat |
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
verses.english: The sacrifice offered with a view verily to fruit, and also indeed for self-glorification, O best of the Bhâratas; know thou that to be of passion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The sacrifice contrary to the ordinances, without distributing food, devoid of words of power and without gifts, empty of faith, is said to be of darkness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Worship given to the Gods, to the twice-born, to the teachers and to the wise, purity, straightforwardness, continence and harmlessness, are called the austerity of the body.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
iast: anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat |
verses.english: Speech causing no annoyance, truthful, pleasant and beneficial, the practice of the study of the Scriptures, are called the austerity of speech.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Mental happiness, equilibrium, silence, self-control, purity of nature—these are called the austerity of the mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: This threefold austerity, performed by men with the utmost faith, without desire for fruit, harmonised, is said to be pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The austerity which is practised with the object of gaining respect, honour and worship, and for ostentation, is said to be of passion, unstable and fleeting.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That austerity done under a deluded understanding, with self-torture, or with the object of destroying another, that is declared of darkness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
iast: deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam ||
verses.english: That alms given to one who does nothing in return, believing that a gift ought to be made in a fit place and time to a worthy person, that alms is accounted pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
iast: dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
verses.english: That given with a view to receiving in return, or looking for fruit again, or grudgingly, that alms is accounted of passion.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That alms given at unfit place and time, and to unworthy persons, disrespectfully and contemptuously, that is declared of darkness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: " Aum Tat Sat ," this has been considered to be the threefold designation of the Eternal . By that were ordained of old Brâhmanas, Vedas and sacrifices.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Therefore with the pronunciation of " Aum " the acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity as laid down in the ordinances are always commenced by the knowers of the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: With the pronunciation of " Tat " and without aiming at fruit are performed the various acts of sacrifice, austerity and gift, by those desiring liberation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते ॥
iast: praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ||
verses.english: " Sat " is used in the sense of reality and goodness; likewise, O Pârtha, the word " Sat " is used in the sense of a good work.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते ।
iast: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate |
verses.english: Steadfastness in sacrifice, austerity and gift is also called " Sat ", and action for the sake of the Supreme is also named " Sat ."

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् ।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह ॥
iast: aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat |
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatprepya no iha ||
verses.english: Whatsoever is wrought without faith, oblation, gift, austerity, or other deed, "Asat" it is called, O Pârtha; it is nought, here or hereafter.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Arjuna said: I desire, O mighty-armed, to know severally the essence of renunciation, O Hrishîkesha, and of relinquishment, O Keshinishûdana.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
iast: kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ |
verses.english: The Blessed Lord said: Sages have known as renunciation the renouncing of works with desire; the relinquishing of the fruit of all actions is called relinquishment by the wise.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: "Action should be relinquished as an evil," declare some thoughtful men; "acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished," say others.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
iast: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama |
verses.english: Hear my conclusions as to that relinquishment, O best of the Bhâratas; since relinquishment, O tiger of men, has been explained as threefold.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be relinquished, but should be performed; sacrifice, gift and also austerity are the purifiers of the intelligent.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च ।
iast: etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca |
verses.english: But even these actions should be done leaving aside attachment and fruit, O Pârtha; that is my certain and best belief.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Verily renunciation of actions that are prescribed is not proper; the relinquishment thereof from delusion is said to be of darkness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥
iast: sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet ||
verses.english: He who relinquisheth an action from fear of physical suffering, saying "Painful," thus performing a passionate relinquishment, obtaineth not the fruit of relinquishment.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥
iast: saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ ||
verses.english: He who performeth a prescribed action, saying, "it ought to be done," O Arjuna, relinquishing attachment and also fruit, that relinquishment is regarded as pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The relinquisher pervaded by purity, intelligent and with doubts cut away, hateth not unpleasurable action nor is attached to pleasurable.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
iast: na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ |
verses.english: Nor indeed can embodied beings completely relinquish action; verily he who relinquisheth the fruit of action, he is said to be a relinquisher.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित् ॥
iast: aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam |
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit ||
verses.english: Good, evil and mixed—threefold is the fruit of action hereafter for the non-relinquisher; but there is none ever for the renouncer.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: These five causes, O mighty-armed, learn of Me as declared in the Sâñkhya system for the accomplishment of all actions:

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् ।
iast: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham |
verses.english: The body, the actor, the various organs, the diverse kinds of energies, and the presiding deities also, the fifth.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥
iast: nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ||
verses.english: Whatever action a man performeth by his body, speech and mind, whether right or the reverse, these five are the cause thereof.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
iast: tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ |
verses.english: That being so, he verily who—owing to untrained Reason—looketh on his Self , which is isolated, as the actor, he of perverted intelligence, seeth not.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते ।
हत्वाऽपि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥
iast: yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate |
hatvā’api sa imā.Nllokānna hanti na nibadhyate ||
verses.english: He who is free from the egoistic notion, whose Reason is not affected, though he slay these peoples, he slayeth not, nor is bound.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Knowledge, the knowable and the knower, the threefold impulse to action; the organ, the action, the actor, the threefold constituents of action.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ताच त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
iast: jñānaṃ karma ca kartāca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ |
verses.english: Knowledge, action and actor in the category of qualities are also said to be severally threefold, from the difference of qualities; hear thou duly these also.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That by which one indestructible Being is seen in all beings, inseparate in the separated, know thou that knowledge as pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
iast: vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
verses.english: But that knowledge which regardeth the several manifold existences in all beings as separate, that knowledge know thou as of passion;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: While that which clingeth to each one thing as if it were the whole, without reason, without grasping the reality, narrow, that is declared to be dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: An action which is ordained, done by one undesirous of fruit, devoid of attachment, without love or hate, that is called pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
iast: yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ |
verses.english: But that action that is done by one longing for desires, or again with egoism, or with much effort, that is declared to be passionate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The action undertaken from delusion, without regard to capacity and consequences—loss and injury to others—that is declared to be dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Liberated from attachment, not egoistic, endued with firmness and confidence, unchanged by success or failure, that actor is called pure.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Impassioned, desiring to obtain the fruit of actions, greedy, harmful, impure, moved by joy and sorrow, such an actor is pronounced passionate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
iast: viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||
verses.english: Discordant, vulgar, stubborn, cheating, malicious, indolent, despairful, procrastinating, that actor is called dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The division of Reason and of firmness also, threefold according to the qualities, hear thou related, unreservedly and severally, O Dhananjaya.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
iast: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye |
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
verses.english: That which knoweth energy and abstinence, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and liberation, that Reason is pure, O Pârtha.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
iast: yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca |
verses.english: That by which one understandeth away Right and Wrong and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, that Reason, O Pârtha, is passionate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That which, enwrapped in darkness, thinketh wrong to be right and seeth all things subverted, that Reason, O Pârtha, is of darkness.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
iast: prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
verses.english: But the firmness, O Arjuna, by which, from attachment desirous of fruit, one holdeth fast duty, desire and wealth, that firmness, O Pârtha, is passionate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
iast: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca |
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
verses.english: That by which one from stupidity doth not abandon sleep, fear, grief, despair, and also vanity, that firmness, O Pârtha, is dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
iast: sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha |
verses.english: And now the threefold kinds of pleasure hear thou from Me, O bull of the Bhâratas. That in which one by practice rejoiceth, and which putteth an end to pain;

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Which at first is as venom but in the end is as nectar; that pleasure is said to be pure, born of the blissful knowledge of the Self .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That which from the union of the senses with their objects at first is as nectar, but in the end is like venom, that pleasure is accounted passionate.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: That pleasure which both at first and afterwards is delusive of the self, arising from sleep, indolence and heedlessness, that is declared dark.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
iast: na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ |
verses.english: There is not an entity, either on the earth or again in heaven among the Shining Ones, that is liberated from these three qualities, born of Matter.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Of Brâhmanas, Kshattriyas, Vaishyas and Shûdras, O Parantapa, the duties have been distributed, according to the qualities born of their own natures.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness and also uprightness, wisdom, knowledge, belief in God, are the Brâhmana duty, born of his own nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Prowess, splendour, firmness, dexterity, and also not flying from battle, generosity, the nature of a ruler, are the Kshattriya duty, born of his own nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Ploughing, protection of kine, and trade are the Vaishya duty, born of his own nature. Action of the nature of service is the Shûdra duty, born of his own nature.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
iast: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ |
verses.english: Man reacheth perfection by each being intent on his own duty. Listen thou how perfection is won by him who is intent on his own duty.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He from whom is the emanation of beings, by Whom all This is pervaded, by worshipping Him in his own duty a man winneth perfection.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Better is one's own duty though destitute of merits than the well-executed duty of another. He who doeth the duty laid down by his own nature incurreth not sin.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
iast: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet |
verses.english: Congenital duty, O son of Kunti, though defective, ought not to be abandoned. All undertakings indeed are clouded by defects as fire by smoke.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He whose Reason is everywhere unattached, the self-subdued, dead to desires, he goeth by renunciation to the supreme perfection of freedom from obligation.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
iast: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||
verses.english: How he who hath attained perfection obtaineth the Eternal , that highest state of wisdom, learn thou from Me only succinctly, O Kaunteya.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
iast: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca |
verses.english: United to this Reason, purified, controlling the self by firmness, having abandoned sound and the other objects of the senses, having laid aside passion and malice,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Dwelling in solitude, abstemious, speech, body and mind subdued, constantly fixed in meditation and yoga, taking refuge in dispassion,

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
iast: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham |
verses.english: Having cast aside egoism, violence, arrogance, desire, wrath, covetousness, selfless and peaceful—he is fit to become the Eternal .

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
iast: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām ||
