verses.english: Becoming the Eternal , serene in the Self , he neither grieveth nor desireth; the same to all beings, he obtaineth supreme devotion unto Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
iast: tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram ||
verses.english: By devotion he knoweth Me in essence, who and what I am; having thus known Me in essence he forthwith entereth into the Supreme.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Though ever performing all actions, taking refuge in Me, by My grace he obtaineth the eternal indestructible abode.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Renouncing mentally all works in Me, intent on Me, resorting to the yoga of discrimination, have thy thought ever on Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thinking on Me, thou shalt overcome all obstacles by My grace: but if from egoism thou wilt not listen, thou shalt be destroyed utterly.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Entrenched in egoism, thou thinkest, "I will not fight;" to no purpose thy determination; nature will constrain thee.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: O son of Kuntî, bound by thine own duty born of thine own nature, that which from delusion thou desirest not to do, even that helplessly thou shalt perform.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The Lord dwelleth in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, by His illusive Power causing all beings to revolve, as though mounted on a potter's wheel.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Flee unto Him for shelter with all thy being, O Bhârata; by His grace thou shalt obtain supreme peace, the everlasting dwelling-place.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Thus hath wisdom, more secret than secrecy itself, been declared unto thee by Me; having reflected on it fully, then act thou as thou listest.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
iast: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
iṣṭo’asi me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam ||
verses.english: Listen thou again to My supreme word, most secret of all; beloved art thou of Me, and steadfast of heart, therefore will I speak for thy benefit.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥
iast: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo’asi me ||
verses.english: Merge thy mind in Me, be my devotee, sacrifice to Me, prostrate thyself before Me, thou shalt come even to Me. I pledge thee My troth; thou art dear to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
iast: ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣyayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ||
verses.english: Abandoning all duties come unto Me alone for shelter; sorrow not, I will liberate thee from all sins.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति ॥
iast: na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo’abhyasūyati ||
verses.english: Never is this to be spoken by thee to anyone who is without asceticism, nor without devotion, nor to one who desireth not to listen, nor yet to him who speaketh evil of Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: He who shall declare this supreme secret among My devotees, having shown the highest devotion for Me, without doubt he shall come to Me.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
iast: bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi ||
verses.english: Nor is there any among men who performeth dearer service to Me than he, nor any other shall be more beloved by Me on earth than he.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
deva: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
iast: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ |
verses.english: And he who shall study this sacred dialogue of ours, by him I shall be worshipped with the sacrifice of wisdom. Such is My mind.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: The man also who, full of faith, merely heareth it unreviling, even he, freed from evil, obtaineth the radiant worlds of the righteous.

verses.speaker: श्रीभगवान्
verses.english: Hath this been heard, O son of Prithâ, with one-pointed mind? Has thy delusion, caused by unwisdom, been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.english: Arjuna said: Destroyed is my delusion. I have gained knowledge through Thy grace, O Immutable one. I am firm, my doubts have fled away. I will do according to Thy word.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: Sanjaya said: I heard this marvellous dialogue of Vâsudeva, and of the great-souled Partha, causing my hair to stand on end.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: By the favour of Vyâsa I listened to this secret and supreme yoga from the Lord of Yoga, Krishna Himself, speaking before mine eyes.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.english: O King, remembering, remembering this marvellous and holy dialogue between Keshava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
iast: vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ ||
verses.english: Remembering, remembering, also that most marvellous form of Hari, great is my wonder, O King. I rejoice, again and again.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
deva: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
iast: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ |
verses.english: Wherever is Krishna, Yoga's Lord, wherever is Pârtha, the archer, assured are there prosperity, victory and happiness. So I think.

iast: OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde arjunaviṣādayogo nāma prathamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde sāṅkhyayogo nāma dvitīyo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde karmayogo nāma tṛtīyo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānakarmasaṃnyāsayogo nāma caturtho’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde saṃnyāsayogo nāma pañcamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde ātmasaṃyamayogo nāma ṣaṣṭho’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde jñānavijñānayogo nāma saptamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde akṣarabrahmayogo nāmāṣṭamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde rājavidyārājaguhyayogo nāma navamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde vibhūtiyogo nāma daśamo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde viśvarūpadarśanayogo nāmaikādaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde bhaktiyogo nāma dvādaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde kṣetrakṣetrajñavibhāgayogo nāma trayodaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde guṇatrayavibhāgayogo nāma caturdaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjuna saṃvāde puruṣottamayogo nāma pañcadaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
OM tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde daivāsurasampadvibhāgayogo nāma ṣoḍaśo’adhyāyaḥ ||
